newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: GVT APPEALS FOR 240 MLN LITAS CREDIT GUARANTEE.
newsitem.headline: GVT APPEALS FOR 240 MLN LITAS CREDIT GUARANTEE.

text.p: The Lithuanian government said on Monday that it decided to appeal to parliament to issue a state guarantee for 240 million litas to the Agricultural Bank and Vilniaus Bank for credits to grain processing companies.
The draft project says that the state guarantees should be issued for 160 million litas to Agricultural Bank and for 80 million litas to Vilniaus Bank, the government said in a statement.

The statement also said that the credits of the two banks will be used to buy the 344,000 tonnes of grain from the country's farmers and agricultural cooperatives and the interest rate for the credits should not exceed 12 percent.
The government expects that the draft project will be discussed in the emergency session of parliament on Monday.
